frozenPredeclaredWindows.registration: Map declared envelopes through actual pane bounds. Register the complete table exterior using all visible boundary segments without choosing a model or fitting text. Missing/ambiguous boundaries hold the property; never move or enlarge an envelope after inspection.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.textRule: All glyphs of the exact named literal must be readable in its own frozen window; presence elsewhere or partial/inferred text gives zero credit.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.dividerRule: Upper/lower divider bands require a vertical separator with colored body on either side; horizontal outer borders and caption ink cannot supply it. Score full blue merged span and absence/presence of orange HIDDEN body separately. Whole table outside the fixed envelope or unreadable lower control is NOT OBSERVED.

notObservedCauses: subject required named table exterior absent or unreadable

The native legend covers the entire exposed upper table top boundary, so a complete independent subject exterior cannot be registered. It also covers required upper body pixels. The lower control body/window intersects the TradingView watermark. Complete glyphs and exposed divider pixels do not repair those missing boundaries/body windows.
scope: Complete per-object fixed envelopes, exterior registration, body/text/individual frame bands/divider strips; raw scan pointers do not complete unreadable glyphs or infer occluded structures.
